+---

+- 01M4BXV22HHY1EYE8XEVSV23GW
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: A parent run does not end before it answers each message mail of a child
+---
+## What
+A child can send a message and then end at once. The parent run must answer that message mail before the idle rule lets it end. The parent run must not miss the message.
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/ParentSessionWatch.swift`: record each `SessionEvent.runMessage(OperationEvent)`, keyed by `correlationID`, next to the `.runSettled` details (:50-113).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+Drive.swift`:
+  - Do an idle check after `.runMessage` as well as after `.runSettled` (:197-237).
+  - `isIdle(on:)` (:261) gives `false` while a recorded message is not in a prompt that a later answer replied to. This is the same rule that the pending envelopes use.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRunProgress.swift`: `check agent` on the parent shows the last message of a child as its last event, if the progress view shows events of that kind.
+
+Notes:
+- The Router puts the message mail and a settled terminal of the same child in one submission, or in two, in outbox order. Both orders must work.
+- The Router withdraws staged messages of a run that settles in its inline grace. A start agent call in a Router session always gets the pending envelope, so this case must not occur for a child run. A test proves it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A child that calls `send caller` and then ends at once: the parent answers the message mail and the final message, and only then ends. The final message of the parent is the reply of its last answer.
+- [ ] A child that sends two messages: the parent answers both before it ends.
+- [ ] A child that sends a message while the parent is in its task turn: the message waits until that answer ends, and then the parent answers it.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/NestedRunTests+Messages.swift` with the scripted model: the three cases above, and the two delivery orders.
+- [ ] Live test in `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/LiveNestedTests.swift`: a parent starts a child whose prompt tells it to send one progress message to its caller and then finish. Assert that the parent transcript has a `.runMessage` and that the parent finishes.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes. The integration package `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then do the implementation until they pass. #waits-on-router
\ No newline at end of file
